# MaximumPixel Creative Video Studio

> Jaipur's premier creative video studio specializing in on-location 4K Video Shoots, Viral Instagram Reels Editing, and Turnkey Shoot + Edit productions for cafes, restaurants, fashion brands, and content creators.

## About MaximumPixel
- **Brand Name**: MaximumPixel (also known as Maximum Pixel Studio)
- **Headquarters**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, 302001, India
- **Core Specialization**: On-location mobile cinematography, high-retention vertical video editing (Reels/Shorts/TikTok), and turnkey all-in-one shoot + edit video bundles.
- **Founding Team**: Krishna Rajak (Founder & Creative Director), Vishwajeet Barman (Co-Founder & Visual Lead), Rahul Gyanchandani (Co-Founder & Strategist).
- **Contact & WhatsApp**: +91 78787 36798
- **Email**: info@maximumpixel.online
- **Official Website**: https://www.maximumpixel.online

## Core Services & Pricing Packages
1. **Video Shoot (On-Location Filming)**:
   - Starting at ₹1,499 for 1–2 hour sessions in Jaipur.
   - Includes 4K 10-bit mobile cinematography, multi-angle gimbal movement, on-location lighting, and creative direction for cafes, restaurants, gyms, and retail stores.
2. **Video Editing (Reels Post-Production)**:
   - Starting at ₹499 per reel.
   - Includes kinetic animated typography, audio foley sound design, velocity speed ramps, and color grading optimized for algorithmic reach.
3. **Turnkey Shoot + Edit Bundles (Most Popular)**:
   - Starter Bundle: ₹2,499 (1 shoot session + 2 master 4K reels).
   - Growth Bundle: ₹4,499 (1 shoot session up to 3 hrs + 4 master 4K reels).
   - Scale Bundle: ₹7,499 (1 half-day shoot session + 8 master 4K reels).
   - Monthly Retainer: ₹9,999 (1 full-day shoot + 12 ready-to-post master reels).

## Turnaround Times
- Single Reel Edits: 24 to 48 hours.
- Turnkey Shoot + Edit Bundles: 48 to 72 hours.
- Revisions: Free revision cycles included with every package.
